about: Per court: where its official filing rules live (direct URLs, or a landing page plus a link pattern so a reissued document is picked up on the next run) and real filed books of authorities. Court ids are Authorities preset ids. Official URLs were seeded from docs/decisions/court-output-preset-receipts.json. Fetch with: python experiments/legal_pdf_corpus/corpus_store.py sync
